In heavy quarry extraction and infrastructure operations, hydraulic fluid dynamics dictate overall cycle times and fuel burn. Modern closed-center load sensing systems regulate hydraulic flow based on operator demand rather than engine RPM, reducing parasitic energy losses across all hydraulic circuits.
